Class EasterCalculator

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.calendar.rule.EasterCalculator
public final class EasterCalculator extends Object
Calculates the date of Easter Sunday, from which a substantial part of the European exchange holidays is derived.

Good Friday, Easter Monday, Ascension, Whit Monday and Corpus Christi are all defined as a fixed distance from Easter Sunday, so a single calculation covers them all. Both the Western (Gregorian) and the Orthodox (Julian) computus are provided because they yield different Sundays in most years.

  • Method Details

    • westernEaster

      public static LocalDate westernEaster(int year)
      Returns Western (Gregorian) Easter Sunday using the Anonymous Gregorian algorithm, also known as the Meeus/Jones/Butcher algorithm. It is exact for all years in the Gregorian calendar.
      Parameters:
      year - the Gregorian year
      Returns:
      the date of Easter Sunday in that year

    • orthodoxEaster

      public static LocalDate orthodoxEaster(int year)
      Returns Orthodox (Julian) Easter Sunday expressed as a Gregorian date. The Julian computus is applied and the result is then shifted by the Julian-to-Gregorian offset, which is 13 days for the years 1900 to 2099 and therefore constant across the whole range GT supports.
      Parameters:
      year - the Gregorian year
      Returns:
      the date of Orthodox Easter Sunday in that year, in the Gregorian calendar
